name: BioMarin Pharmaceutical
outlook:
What BioMarin Pharmaceutical says to expect

  • Full year 2026: acquired research chargesBioMarin expects the Alesta acquisition and BMN 450 license agreement to result in total pre-tax charges of approximately $320 million and $83 million, respectively, for the full year 2026, consisting of the acquired IPR&D charges and ongoing operating expenses, representing an unfavorable impact of approximately $1.55 and $0.32, respectively, to both GAAP Diluted EPS and Non-GAAP Diluted EPS for the full year 2026.
  • Through 2028: Amicus cost synergiesBioMarin continues to expect approximately $280 million of GAAP cost synergies (approximately $220 million on a Non-GAAP basis) to be fully realized in 2028.
The company's own words, from its earnings release (Form 8-K, Exhibit 99), filed November 2, 2026. They are its expectations, not ours, and not a forecast or price target from The Filing Desk. Replaced when the next release is out.
